summary: VIS Entertainment's crowd-heavy riot action series, published first by Rockstar and then SouthPeak.

entries.title: State of Emergency

emulation.notes: Use Windows for the main run; emulate PS2/Xbox only for original-platform comparison.

primary.why: State of Emergency released for PlayStation 2, Xbox, and Windows. Windows is the highest-fidelity route for the original crowd-action brawler.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version natively with compatibility fixes if needed; use PS2 or Xbox only for original-console comparison.

all_releases.fidelity: PC release by Global Star Software.

all_releases.reason: skip: original route but lower practical fidelity than Windows.
skip: original console route but no sourced content advantage over Windows.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive content requires a secondary route; Windows is the fidelity pick.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster is documented in the cited public source.

entries.title: State of Emergency 2

emulation.notes: Original PS2 hardware is the reference route; PCSX2 can upscale for preservation.

primary.why: State of Emergency 2 released exclusively for PlayStation 2 after planned PSP, Xbox, and Windows versions were canceled. PS2 is the only shipped platform and therefore the primary route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PlayStation 2 hardware or use PCSX2 with owned media for upscaling and preservation.

all_releases.fidelity: Only released version; PS2 exclusive after other planned platforms were canceled.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only one shipped platform release exists.

entries.remaster_caveats: Planned PSP, Xbox, and Windows versions were canceled; no modern remaster is documented.
